cand.title: Ecomondo Mexico 2027
cand.excerpt: Strong event evidence and clear Guadalajara demand mechanism; accessibility is discounted where the venue or incumbent hotel is confirmed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Verified commercially relevant organizer contacts: Alejandra Vázquez and Paulina Sánchez, both Sales Managers with published event contact emails; Samuel Ramírez, Director of RE+ Mexico and Ecomondo Mexico; and Damián Arias, Director of Operations on the current corporate team page and operations contact in the 2026 handbook. Sales can route a hotel proposal; the event director and operations contact can identify the accommodation decision-maker. No source establishes that any of them controls hotel contracts.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming: April 20–22, 2027 at Expo Guadalajara, Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico. These are activity dates on the organizer’s event page, independently corroborated by the parent event network, not publication dates. Within the requested horizon. Edition numbering is inconsistent: the current About page calls 2027 the fifth edition, whereas the parent network describes the completed edition as fifth and references 2026. Retain the year-based identity; do not rely on the ordinal. No 2028 dates verified.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel profile: an Expo-adjacent, 216-room full-service Sheraton is well aligned to visiting exhibitors, international delegations and business attendees needing guestrooms near the exhibition, with possible small briefings or hospitality meetings. City-hotel convenience is more directly aligned than a resort proposition. The organizer’s international-market positioning and existing nearby-hotel programme support the demand mechanism, but do not establish overnight conversion, room nights, meeting bookings or a block suitable for all 216 rooms.
findings.venueCommitments: Expo Guadalajara is the publicly announced 2027 exhibition venue; no signed venue contract was inspected. It is a convention/exhibition center, not an incumbent hotel. A confirmed exhibition venue does not close off guestrooms at nearby hotels. The 2026 handbook names Jalisco Hall E; that hall assignment must not be carried into 2027.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified sequence: July 12–14, 2022, Poliforum León, León, Guanajuato; April 26–28, 2023, Expo Guadalajara; April 17–19, 2024, Expo Guadalajara; March 5–7, 2025, Expo Guadalajara; April 14–16, 2026, Expo Guadalajara. Thus the record shows a move from León to Guadalajara followed by repeated Guadalajara hosting, not a continuing destination-rotation policy. These historical editions establish recurrence; they are not upcoming opportunities.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing status: unknown/unconfirmed, neither verified open nor verified closed. The 2026 exhibitor handbook sends exhibitors to organizer-recommended special-rate hotels and tells them to use the corresponding booking code. The official hotel page says preferential rates were negotiated, but several codes explicitly reference 2026. This supports an organizer-promoted hotel referral/code pathway, not a verified centrally guaranteed room block. No 2027-specific hotel allocation, procurement timetable, RFP, hotel onboarding form, or named housing agency/PCO/DMC was located. Existing hotel-page variants are not proof of 2027 commitments.
findings.organizationStructure: Corporate exhibition organizer, not an association: IGECO (Italian German Exhibition Company), a joint venture of Italian Exhibition Group SpA and Deutsche Messe AG, organizes Ecomondo Mexico alongside RE+ Mexico. The supplied sports_entertainment segment is inconsistent with the verified industrial/environmental B2B trade-exhibition format. Expo Guadalajara is the venue, not the event owner or proven accommodation buyer.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The official hotel page lists 13 alternatives: The Westin Guadalajara, Barceló Guadalajara, IBIS Expo Guadalajara, Fiesta Inn Guadalajara Expo, AC Marriot Guadalajara Expo, RIU Plaza Guadalajara, Hotel Presidente InterContinental Guadalajara, One Guadalajara Expo, City Express Plus, Holiday Inn Guadalajara Expo, Holiday Inn Guadalajara Select, Wyndham Garden and Hampton by Hilton. Treat these as published legacy/preferred-rate competitors, not confirmed 2027 contracted incumbents; some codes expressly say 2026. Sheraton is not listed on the reviewed page. No sourced sold-out, compression, waitlist, displaced-delegate or overflow evidence was found. No exclusivity or competing room-block sizes verified.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Alejandra Vázquez and Paulina Sánchez with an Expo-adjacent guestrooms and small-meeting proposal, asking for referral to Samuel Ramírez and the housing/vendor decision-maker; include Damián Arias for the operating pathway. First verify whether the hotel list and codes apply to 2027, whether hotel additions are considered, who signs agreements, existing exclusivity, decision timing, and delegation/exhibitor room needs. Only then quote an availability-backed rate/code or block. If 2027 is closed, request the next review date and permission for independent exhibitor outreach; do not claim an RFP or overflow requirement.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: As of the supplied research date, the next edition is April 2027. Exhibition access is committed to Expo Guadalajara, but accommodation accessibility remains unconfirmed. A hotel-partner addition or direct exhibitor/delegation sale is a plausible route, not a verified available allocation. Do not present the existing rate programme as an open bid or presume all demand is committed elsewhere.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: repeated Expo Guadalajara hosting and a published hotel referral programme support relationship-led competition for future preferred-hotel inclusion and exhibitor/delegation stays. The 2027 edition is confirmed; any 2028 edition/date, hotel re-tender or future destination commitment remains unverified. Future capture depends on organizer confirmation of programme review timing, contractual limitations and the actual room-demand mix.
